label: In every possible history, each moment with a contingent concrete thing present has a begun past
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: in every history accessible from the selected world, every moment at which some contingent concrete individual is present has a past with a beginning (some moment at or before it has no earlier moment). It denies the begun version of horn H2 (a beginningless past at a populated moment) wherever a contingent concrete thing is present; histories with no contingent concrete thing present are unconstrained. Unlike founded populated pasts it allows continuous time with a first moment. It is not a metric finitude claim and mentions no cause. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter.
